title: Timeout-based local POSIX process group termination
summary: Each local foreground process is in an isolated session. On configured timeout, Computer sends SIGTERM to that process group and attempts SIGKILL after a bounded grace period, then records termination evidence.
invariants: Exception registration and observation are report-only.
Timeout termination never proves remote, detached or uninterruptible descendants stopped.
Metadata distinguishes termination attempt, scope, signals, errors and direct-child reaping.
Never signal Computer's own process group.
